content.text: {"class": "ENVIRONMENT_CONFIG", "reasoning": "The 401 comes from the identity provider rejecting the orders-service's own client credentials ('client secret expired 2026-09-18', with the secret store showing a 90-day rotation policy overdue since 2026-06-20 rotation), not from anything wrong with the user token, which was freshly minted with a 900s TTL.
